title: Bookkeeper
description:
The Opportunity

A well-established independent firm of Chartered Accountants in Tarporley is looking for an experienced Bookkeeper to join its growing team.

This isn't a role where you'll spend every day processing the same type of client. You'll manage the bookkeeping for a genuinely varied portfolio of owner-managed businesses, ranging from trades and hauliers through to farmers, consultants and other SMEs.

The firm is looking for someone who can take ownership of their work, build relationships with clients and, most importantly, get the numbers right rather than simply getting the job done.

The Role:
- Maintaining accurate accounting records
- Bank and control account reconciliations
- Processing purchase and sales transactions
- Supporting clients with their bookkeeping queries
- Managing bookkeeping across businesses with very different requirements
- Working predominantly with Xero
- Using other platforms including QuickBooks, Sage and FreeAgent where required
- Working directly with clients to obtain information and resolve queries
- Ensuring records are accurate and up to date
- Working independently while having support from the wider team when required

Xero will be the main platform used day-to-day, although experience with other cloud accounting packages would be useful.

The Candidate:
- Previous bookkeeping experience within accountancy practice or a multi-client environment
- Strong knowledge of Xero
- Experience with QuickBooks, Sage or FreeAgent would be advantageous
- Excellent attention to detail
- The ability to manage your own workload
- Confidence dealing directly with clients
- A practical and organised approach
- The ability to adapt between different clients and industries

What's On Offer:
- Flexible working environment
- Varied owner-managed business portfolio
- Significant client contact
- Exposure to businesses across numerous sectors
- Supportive and experienced team
- Long-term career stability
- Opportunity to join an independent firm where your contribution is noticed

title: Bookkeeper
description:
Our client are an independent firm of Chartered Accountants serving owner-managed businesses across Cheshire and the surrounding area.

The important client work you will be doing:

You will be managing the books for a genuinely varied portfolio of owner-managed businesses - from trades and hauliers to farmers and consultants. No two clients look the same, and that's exactly how we like it. One day you might be reconciling a courier company's fuel and vehicle costs, the next you could be getting your head around farm income or a consultant's project-based invoicing.

You will be working mainly in Xero, so you should be comfortable and confident in it day-to-day. We also work with clients on other platforms, so a working knowledge of alternatives (QuickBooks, Sage, FreeAgent or similar) will really help.
- You can actually do the job - accurately, independently, with support from your colleagues when needed.
- You are comfortable switching between different types of business and different ways of working.
- You take pride in getting the numbers right, not just done.
- You fit with how we work: independent, personal, straightforward.

What's on offer:
- £26,000 - £35,000+
- A good mix of clients from a range of sectors and the chance to broaden your technical experience.
- Direct support and regular review from experienced client managers.
- Ongoing training, and support for further professional study and progression.
- Flexi-time working arrangements.
- A friendly, independent firm where your contribution is visible and valued.

title: Finance Administrator
description:
Finance Administrator
12 Month Maternity Contract
Cheshire - Office Based
Up to £27,000 + Benefits

Are you a highly organised administrator with experience in finance operations, invoicing or transactional processes?

We're working with a successful and growing Cheshire-based organisation looking to add a Finance Administrator to its established finance team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working with numbers, solving problems and ensuring financial information is processed accurately and efficiently.

- The opportunity to work in a business finance function, and

title: Purchase Ledger Clerk
company: Anderson Wright Consulting Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
PURCHASE LEDGER CLERK / ACCOUNTS PAYABLE ASSISTANT

WINSFORD £28,000-£30,000 PER ANNUM

Location: Winsford, Cheshire

Salary: £28,000-£30,000 per annum, depending on experience

Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Hours: Monday to Thursday, 8.30am-5.00pm; Friday, 8.30am-4.00pm

We are working with an established and successful company based in Winsford that is looking to recruit an experienced Purchase Ledger Clerk / Accounts Payable Assistant to join its finance team.

This is an excellent opportunity for an organised, detail-oriented finance professional who enjoys working in a busy environment and takes pride in maintaining accurate financial records.

The successful candidate will play an important role in the day-to-day running of the purchase ledger function, ensuring supplier invoices, payments and reconciliations are processed accurately and efficiently.

PURCHASE LEDGER JOB RESPONSIBILITIES
- Maintain an accurate and up-to-date purchase ledger, ensuring all transactions are correctly recorded.
- Process supplier invoices, checking accuracy and matching against purchase orders and goods received.
- Reconcile supplier statements, investigating and resolving discrepancies.
- Monitor and reconcile Goods Received Not Invoiced (GRNI) balances, including outstanding purchase orders and unmatched receipts.
- Prepare and process supplier payments accurately and within agreed deadlines.
- Handle purchase ledger and payment queries, liaising with suppliers, internal departments and service providers.
- Produce weekly and monthly financial reports for the management team.
- Assist with general finance administration, including answering telephone enquiries.
- Support the wider finance team with additional accounting and administrative duties as required.

PURCHASE LEDGER SKILLS & EXPERIENCE
- Previous experience working in a Purchase Ledger, Accounts Payable or similar finance role is essential.
- Good understanding of purchase ledger processes, including invoice matching, supplier reconciliations and payment processing.
- Experience with GRNI reconciliations and purchase order processing.
- AAT Level 2 qualification or currently studying towards AAT would be advantageous.
- Experience using Oracle NetSuite would be desirable, although not essential.
- Confident working with computerised accounting systems and paperless finance processes.
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritise workloads and meet deadlines.
- Good communication skills, with the confidence to liaise professionally with suppliers and colleagues.
- A proactive, reliable and flexible approach to work.

PURCHASE LEDGER SALARY & BENEFITS
- Salary of £28,000-£30,000 per annum, depending on experience.
- Full-time, permanent position.
- Monday to Thursday, 8.30am-5.00pm.
- Early finish on Fridays at 4.00pm.
- 20 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Christmas shutdown.
- Health and wellbeing programme.
- Free onsite parking.
- Opportunity to join an established and supportive finance team.

APPLY NOW

If you are an experienced Purchase Ledger Clerk, Accounts Payable Assistant or Finance Assistant looking for your next opportunity in Winsford, we would like to hear from you.

Apply today for immediate consideration.
